newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle to announce H1 results on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Nestle to announce H1 results on Friday.

text.p: Nestle SA said it would announce first-half 1996 profit figures on Friday but would not say exactly what time the data would be released.
"They will be coming tomorrow, but I cannot say at what time," a company spokeswoman said. "It is envisioned to be in the morning, but I cannot say any more."

Nestle posted group net profit of 1,118 million Swiss francs in the first half of 1995. Analysts' forecasts for first-half 1996 profit range from 1,200 million to 1,400 million. The company said in July that first-half sales rose 5.8 percent to 28.4 billion francs. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
